title: Core Banking Software License (Uncapped Liability)
description: Enterprise software license with an explicit uncapped liability clause and 120 days termination notice.

payment_terms.quote: Payment shall be completed under Net 60 days from invoice generation.

price_adjustment.quote: Annual maintenance fees are subject to mutual agreement and renegotiated annually.

contract_term.quote: The initial term of this Agreement shall be 60 months starting September 1, 2024.

auto_renewal.quote: The maintenance tier will automatically renew for successive 12-month periods.

termination_notice.quote: Either party may terminate maintenance upon written notice of at least 120 days.

liability_cap.quote: Licensor agrees that aggregate liability is unlimited and uncapped liability applies for security breaches or ledger loss.

governing_law.quote: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York.

volume_commitment.quote: No volume commitment is required under this site-wide deployment model.
